assets.name: lecture_05_figure_01.png
assets.rationale: The pendulum, angle, rod length, and horizontal projection are complete and unobstructed.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: The pendulum length does not change.

assets.name: lecture_05_figure_02.png
assets.rationale: The kinetic energy, negative gravitational potential, and resulting Lagrangian are visible together.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: Two minus signs make a plus sign.

assets.name: lecture_05_figure_03.png
assets.rationale: The completed Euler--Lagrange equation is visible beneath the pendulum Lagrangian.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: We can cancel out the masses.

assets.name: lecture_05_figure_04.png
assets.rationale: The coupled kinetic term, potential, full Lagrangian, and common angle shift appear together.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: The derivative of the Lagrangian with respect to theta.

assets.name: lecture_05_figure_05.png
assets.rationale: The canonical momentum and completed Hamiltonian calculation are legible without hand occlusion.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: We want to pass now to the Hamiltonian form.

assets.name: lecture_05_figure_06.png
assets.rationale: Both Cartesian components of the lower bob's velocity contain their two complete contributions.

assets.name: lecture_05_figure_07.png
assets.rationale: Both canonical momenta and their conserved sum are complete and unobstructed.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: This is the thing which does not change with time.

assets.name: lecture_05_figure_08.png
assets.rationale: The exact cosine potential and its parabolic approximation are shown around the same stable minimum.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: Near the bottom it looks like a parabola.

assets.name: lecture_05_figure_09.png
assets.rationale: The oscillator equation, cosine trial function, and frequency relation are simultaneously visible.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: This would also work for sine.

assets.name: lecture_05_figure_10.png
assets.rationale: The final Hamiltonian in canonical variables is complete and minimally occluded.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: There is a kind of symmetry between p and x.

assets.name: lecture_05_figure_11.png
assets.rationale: Nested constant-energy ellipses and the position and momentum intercepts are readable.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: The system just moves around on the ellipse.

assets.name: lecture_05_figure_12.png
assets.rationale: A finite patch is visibly transported around the phase portrait while retaining its area.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: Area in phase space is preserved with time.
